startedBy.speaker: Captain Veleth
startedBy.prompt: Did he say what it was about?
reply: All he wanted me to do is track you down and send you to him.
Look, this is important... even more important than wiping out the ash spawn.
Please, go speak to the second councilor as soon as possible.
startedBy.conditions: the speaker is Captain Veleth; Served Cold stage == 5

movedBy.speaker: Adril Arano
reply: I need you to start out by being my eyes and ears... search Raven Rock and see if you can root out these traitors.
The best place to start would be Geldis Sadri over at the Retching Netch Cornerclub.
If he provides you any leads, check them out before bringing them to my attention. I can't afford to make any mistakes.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Adril Arano; Served Cold stage >= 10; Served Cold stage < 20; global DLC2RR02Dia01 == 1 (now 0); global DLC2RR02Dia02 == 1 (now 0)

movedBy.speaker: Adril Arano
movedBy.prompt: I'd prefer not to get involved.
reply: Without Councilor Morvayn, Raven Rock has no future. Keep that in mind next time you decide to help or not.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Adril Arano; Served Cold stage == 10; global DLC2RR02Dia01 == 1 (now 0); global DLC2RR02Dia02 == 0 (now 0)

startedBy.speaker: Glover Mallory
startedBy.prompt: Why all the fuss over a simple pickaxe?
reply: No, no, no. This isn't just your run-of-the-mill pickaxe... I'm talking about an Ancient Nordic Pickaxe.
They don't exactly grow on trees, you know.
startedBy.conditions: the speaker is Glover Mallory; An Axe to Find stage <= 15

startedBy.speaker: Glover Mallory
startedBy.conditions: the speaker is Glover Mallory; An Axe to Find stage <= 15

movedBy.speaker: Crescius Caerellius
movedBy.prompt: Any idea of where to start?
reply: Gratian kept a journal of notes about his discoveries. If you can find his... remains, I'm hoping it will help.
Here's everything I have. The letter, the key. Please, do this for me so I can finally regain the respect that I've lost.
movedBy.conditions: the speaker is Crescius Caerellius; The Final Descent stage == 15; global DLC2RR03Dia01 == 2 (now 0)

why: OnConfigInit runs once when the menu registers in a new game; it sets `migrated` and calls LoadSettings, which goes on only while bEnabled:Maintenance is set (it is 1) and then calls Load, which reads iWTGeneralRequirementsMinimalLevel:Requirements (10, settings.ini in Wyrmstooth - Settings Loader) and sets WTStartLevel to it

MigrateToMCMHelper, which would copy the global's record value (20.0) into that setting, runs only from OnGameReload or OnConfigOpen while `migrated` is false, and OnConfigInit has already set it, so a new game never migrates (an older save made before the loader would)
OnGameReload reloads the settings only when bLoadSettingsonReload:Maintenance is set; it is 0, so later loads keep whatever the global holds
